record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare COLUMN_CRUSH: CONKELDURR (3 stars), GURDURR (2 stars), TIMBURR (1 star); all have range 1 and maxPP 100 and no passive per the unit blocks. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (damage table and pillar type index).
record.summary: Two modes chosen at cast time. If no allied pillar entity is on the board, the caster builds one on the closest free cell (wood / iron / concrete by stars). If an allied pillar already exists, the caster destroys it, jumps onto its cell and, 500 ms later, throws it at the nearest enemy: SPECIAL damage of 50/100/150 (by stars) plus the pillar's remaining HP, landing after distance x 160 ms.

targeting.who: build mode: none (a free cell); throw mode: the nearest targettable enemy at the moment of the 500 ms command (fallback the first enemy in cell order)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false so no walk-up is needed; the cast target argument is null. Ties between equally near enemies are broken by pickRandomIn.

geometry.shape: single target; thrown projectile travel time = Euclidean distance from the pillar cell to the enemy x 160 ms

effects.target: a free cell chosen by getClosestFreeCellToPokemonEntity

declaredRaw.pillar: PILLAR_WOOD / PILLAR_IRON / PILLAR_CONCRETE by caster stars 1 / 2 / 3+

effects.scaling: none in this file. The pillar HP, DEF and SPE_DEF come from the pillar class blocks, not from the source comment (which says 1/3/5 DEF and SPE_DEF; the class blocks say 2/6/10).
effects.resolution: the pillar is an allied, INANIMATE entity added with isSpawn true; nothing is built if no free cell is found (PP is still spent). Whether synergy or item effects change the pillar's stats on spawn was not traced.

declaredRaw.step: moves onto the existing pillar's cell, then waits 500 ms to throw

effects.resolution: the pillar entity is destroyed first (shield 0, 9999 TRUE damage, no attacker), then moveTo(pillarX, pillarY, board, false) puts the caster on that cell with cooldown 100, then resetCooldown(800) overrides it.

effects.target: the chosen enemy (landing after travel time)

declaredRaw.plus: the thrown pillar's HP at the moment of the cast (PILLAR_WOOD up to 100, PILLAR_IRON up to 200, PILLAR_CONCRETE up to 300 at full HP)

effects.scaling: requested = table value + pillar remaining HP (the pillar HP is not star-indexed and is added unscaled before the call). applied by handleSpecialDamage: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default) applies to the whole sum; x critPower if the cast crit. A magicBounce target reflects the SPECIAL hit instead.
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage: divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF, at least 1 (rounded up), shield absorbs before HP; protect / skydiving block it. takenDamage includes shield damage. The damage is skipped if the enemy has hp <= 0 when the command fires.

starBehavior.note: the damage table and the pillar choice are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 300 is not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Build mode needs a free cell (the offset list is tried in priority order, then the first free cell of the team's side). Throw mode needs at least one enemy on the board; with none, the pillar is still destroyed and the caster still moves, but no damage is dealt.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Stateful through the board: the first cast builds a pillar, the next cast (while that pillar is alive) consumes it. A pillar damaged before the throw adds only its remaining HP. A pillar of any allied origin on the caster's team counts, not only one built by this caster. Delayed commands are queued on the caster's command list.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 50/100/150 (1/2/3 stars) plus the pillar's remaining HP (max 100/200/300). Damage dealt = (raw + remaining HP) x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor), then SPE_DEF division, minimum 1; shield damage is included in takenDamage. None is computed here for a specific target.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPE_DEF division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
